scope_notes: The official scope explicitly includes theoretical chemistry, physical chemistry, nanochemistry, polymers, supramolecular chemistry and molecular aspects of related sciences. route.conditions: Original research and reviews are supported. The free route does not require a selective waiver or institutional agreement. Non-generative machine-learning image tools require caption disclosure for case-by-case review.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None under the journal-specific policy: all submissions are processed and published free of charge. No page/colour/member/registration charge or selective waiver is stated; article-length restrictions are editorial.
